QB.name: Jaxson Dart
QB.injury: Sep 30: Dart recently underwent surgery to repair the meniscus and MCL in his left knee, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

QB.name: Jalen Hurts
QB.injury: Oct 19: Hurts (calf) is expected to be held out of football activities for multiple months and miss the rest of the season after new imaging over the weekend revealed several blood clots in his lungs, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

QB.name: Lamar Jackson
QB.injury: Oct 27: Jackson (ankle) is "believed to be close to 100 percent" and is expected to play Sunday versus the Bills, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

QB.name: Marcus Mariota
QB.injury: Oct 26: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Monday that Mariota (knee) is on track to return to practice this week, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

RB.name: Saquon Barkley
RB.injury: Oct 27: Barkley said after Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys that his "hamstring came out great," and noted that the back issue that kept him out for the entire fourth quarter isn't anything that he expects to prevent him from playing Sunday against the Commanders, Tim McManus of ESPN.com reports.

RB.name: Cam Skattebo
RB.injury: Oct 26: Skattebo is expected to "OK" after tweaking his hamstring on a 42-yard run in overtime during Sunday's 27-21 win over the Texans, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

RB.name: Travis Etienne
RB.injury: Oct 1: The Saints are placing Etienne (hamstring) on injured reserve, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

RB.name: De'Von Achane
RB.injury: Sep 28: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

RB.name: Christian McCaffrey
RB.injury: Oct 26: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

RB.name: Aaron Jones
RB.injury: Oct 26: The left knee injury that forced Jones out of Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts isn't considered significant, and the running back is viewed as day-to-day, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

RB.name: Jadarian Price
RB.injury: Oct 26: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price (chest) will be designated for return from injured reserve during Week 8, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

RB.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
RB.injury: Oct 19: The Commanders placed Croskey-Merritt (groin) on injured reserve Monday.

RB.name: Jeremiyah Love
RB.injury: Oct 26: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love (ankle) will take part in Wednesday's practice, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

WR.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
WR.injury: Oct 26: Lions head coach Dan Campbell said that St. Brown tweaked his ankle during Sunday's 20-17 win over the Packers but should be ready to practice Thursday, Richard Silva of The Detroit News reports.

WR.name: Terry McLaurin
WR.injury: Oct 20: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

WR.name: Mike Evans
WR.injury: Oct 26: Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

WR.name: Deebo Samuel
WR.injury: Oct 26: Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

WR.name: Ladd McConkey
WR.injury: Oct 26: McConkey (concussion) was spotted on the field in a no-contact jersey during the Chargers' bonus practice session Monday, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

WR.name: Alec Pierce
WR.injury: Oct 26: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) will "most likely not" have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 8, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

WR.name: Jaylen Waddle
WR.injury: Oct 25: Waddle didn't return to Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals due to a chest injury, Parker Gabriel of the Denver Post reports.

WR.name: Michael Pittman
WR.injury: Oct 10: The Steelers placed Pittman (foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

WR.name: Davante Adams
WR.injury: Oct 20: Adams (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

WR.name: Romeo Doubs
WR.injury: Oct 19: Doubs (shoulder) is hopeful to return after the Patriots' Week 11 bye and isn't expected to face a long-term absence, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

WR.name: Jayden Reed
WR.injury: Sep 30: The Packers are expected to place Reed (neck) on injured reserve Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

WR.name: Rashid Shaheed
WR.injury: Oct 26: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that the early returns on Shaheed's knee injury are positive, Brady Henderson reports.

WR.name: Matthew Golden
WR.injury: Oct 27: Golden (shoulder/foot) didn't participate in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.
